data.title: 圣路易斯 · 顶层公寓落地窗前的侧颜
data.description: 都会高空顶层公寓内，璀璨的都市霓虹在巨大的落地窗外如星河延展。圣路易斯身着一袭贴身的深蓝色深V开衩晚礼服，优雅地单手倚在玻璃窗前。手中轻摇着马提尼酒杯，冰蓝色的长发倾泻在光洁裸背上，转过头来的眼神深邃而充满成熟女性从容的诱惑魅力。
data.location: private penthouse bedroom with dark city panorama
data.action: leaning gracefully against floor-to-ceiling glass window overlooking glittering city skyline, fitted navy evening gown, holding cocktail glass, looking at viewer with seductive knowing smile
data.lighting: vibrant multicolored city neon backlighting paired with subtle indoor mood light
data.promptProse: Standing before a vast penthouse glass window with a sparkling cityscape below, St. Louis wears an elegant backless navy evening gown. She sips a cocktail, turning with an alluring, confident smile.
data.animaCaption: St. Louis holding a cocktail in an evening gown before a dazzling city view from a penthouse window.
